title: Heavier weight than many but shop around.
text: Heavier weight than many but shop around.. Not bad quality ( it was the #1 rated ) but the one I got from Amazon kept grabbing and ripping the paper off the cans. I think it may have been defective so I sent it back and bought a different brand. This model is heavier weight than many of the others and doesn't tend to tip forward.
